On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.

AI.title_zh: 八叉树作为一种显式的三维语言
AI.abstract_zh: 现有的三维大语言模型（LLM）在两方面存在妥协：它们将形状压缩为潜在码本索引或坐标文本，从而使模型所观测的内容失去了空间结构；并且它们通过微调主干网络来获得三维模态，这会覆盖其通用语言能力。我们提出 OctLLM，同时解决这两方面局限。几何以八叉树占据令牌（octree occupancy tokens）的显式三维序列形式输入。然而，完整的八叉树序列随深度迅速增长；因此 OctLLM 随机清空倒数第二层的节点并省略其后代，同时保持形状不变，从而得到一个更短的、以坐标和深度为锚点的稀疏八叉树（Sparse Octree, S-Octree），用于位置感知的掩码建模生成与三维理解。在另一方面，现有方法通过全量微调或 LoRA 引入新模态，但全量微调成本高昂，LoRA 限制了三维容量，且二者都会修改语言通路。OctLLM 则在与预训练参数分离的参数中增加三维容量：网格令牌（mesh tokens）在部分模块中被路由至独立的可训练分支，而文本和图像令牌保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两条流通过共享自注意力进行交互。它训练的参数远少于全量微调，却在统一多模态 LLM 中创下新的最优水平，相比 ShapeLLM-Omni 将图像到三维的 FID 降低 $17.4\%$，并将渲染基础的图像描述（render-grounded captioning）提升 $28.7$ 分，同时在通用语言基准上与主干网络持平。

title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.

AI.title_zh: 重新思考面向组合式与上下文内机器人操作的世界-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 长时域组合式操作对真实世界机器人部署日益重要，其中单个任务涉及多个协同的子任务。现有的世界-动作模型（WAM）联合预测短时域视觉未来与动作，但通常缺乏显式的子任务级推理。我们提出视觉目标条件动作推理（Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning，ViGAR），一个将操作分解为视觉子目标规划器与子目标执行器的分层框架。给定当前观测与全局指令，子目标规划器预测下一个子任务的视觉子目标。随后，子目标执行器以预测的子目标为条件，联合生成未来视觉轨迹与动作。两个组件共享一个预训练的世界模型表征，使得任务级规划与动作生成能够受益于共同的物理知识。此外，我们的框架天然支持上下文内学习：使用全局目标图像作为上下文，可以在无需参数更新的情况下诱导出不同的子任务分解与行为。在 RoboTwin Clean2Random 基准上，ViGAR 在 Clean 与 Random 设置下分别取得 82.00% 和 67.02% 的成功率，平均成功率超过最强基线 12.86 个百分点。在五个组合式任务与两个上下文内学习任务上的真实世界机器人实验进一步证实了 ViGAR 的有效性。

title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
summary: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

AI.title_zh: 世界编辑：在递增深度上对可执行世界进行干预
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式世界模型生成环境并在其中行动的能力日益增强，然而对现有可执行世界进行有意编辑仍未被充分探索。我们将世界编辑形式化为：对现有世界进行干预，同时保持应当保持不变的性质，并引入干预深度（intervention depth）作为一个轴，用以描述编辑对世界实体、动力学与系统的耦合强度。我们通过工业级游戏模组（game modding）实例化这一能力，提出 IGMWorld，以及 IGMBench——一个包含 110 项任务、超过 1.1K 条可执行状态与行为判据的基准，覆盖 Minecraft 与 Terraria。任务涵盖属性、实体、动力学与系统干预，并通过确定性可执行性、行为、保持性与视觉检查进行评测。前沿编码智能体（coding agents）已展现出显著的世界编辑能力：最强配置在严格的任务级判据下解决 78.2% 的任务，而在判据级性能上达到 94.8%。可靠性通常随干预深度增加而下降，且这一模式在评测判据数量相近的任务之间依然存在。大多数失败的编辑仍能成功构建并加载，这表明主要困难在于使编辑后的世界按所要求的方式运行。视觉一致性仍是一项独立的薄弱环节，所有被评测配置的联合视觉通过率均低于 50%。这些结果表明，世界编辑是一种不同于世界生成与世界交互的能力，而可执行游戏为研究这一能力提供了实用的测试平台。
